duplication_audit.novel_axis: fixed one-dimensional Vietoris-Rips loop-persistence summaries of normalized sliding-window delay clouds
duplication_audit.distinction: v36/v36r1 explicitly compute only H0 connected-component deaths equivalent to MST edges; v29 uses one fixed recurrence threshold; v47 uses local curvature and torsion. v61 computes H1 birth-death lifetimes from edges and triangles across the full filtration and uses no prior topology feature or prediction.
duplication_audit.official_v42_exclusion: the aggregate official v42 sign reversal is transport-risk context only and is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.case_normalization: median and IQR before delay embedding; cloud centered and RMS-normalized with epsilon 1e-12
encoder.subsample: deterministic evenly spaced indices including both endpoints
encoder.filtration: exact Euclidean Vietoris-Rips vertices, edges and triangles over Z2; deterministic filtration-dimension-lexicographic order

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Perea and Harer, Sliding Windows and Persistence: An Application of Topological Methods to Signal Analysis, Foundations of Computational Mathematics 15, 799-838 (2015)
primary_sources.use: sliding-window loop-persistence motivation only; not performance evidence

primary_sources.citation: Edelsbrunner, Letscher and Zomorodian, Topological Persistence and Simplification, Discrete & Computational Geometry 28, 511-533 (2002)
primary_sources.use: birth-death persistence algorithm motivation only; not performance evidence
